source_audio.description: Locally generated signal-generator tone — NOT provider output, and no provider was called to produce these bytes. 10001 samples of a symmetric triangle wave, period 64 samples, peak amplitude 11000, written as 16-bit signed little-endian mono at 16000 Hz (the `pcm_s16le` format and 16000 sample_rate LmntTtsOptions requests by default). Generated with integer arithmetic only, deliberately: Math.Sin is not guaranteed bit-identical across platforms and this file is asserted byte-for-byte. The generator is committed as SyntheticPcm.Triangle in this suite and RecordedFixtures_ShouldMatchTheirDocumentedGeneratorParameters_WhenRegeneratedLocally regenerates the file from these three numbers on every run, so the bytes are reproducible rather than magic. 20002 bytes is 7.6% of the 256 KiB cap and is deliberately NOT a multiple of LmntSpeechSynthesizer's 8192-byte HttpChunkSize (2 full reads + a 3618-byte partial), so a partial final chunk reaches the consumer.

redaction.notes: Nothing was redacted because nothing was captured: these bytes were computed locally from three published parameters and carry no vendor speech, no voice and no spoken content of any kind.

terms.basis: docs/guides/provider-recording-protocol.md section 7 — LMNT is not-cleared for capturing Output, so the body half of this surface's fixture pair carries no Output at all

source_schema.method: The page above was read to confirm the route (POST /v1/ai/speech/bytes), that the response is a streaming binary audio body, and that `pcm_s16le` is signed 16-bit little-endian PCM — the three properties these bytes stand in for. Format, sample rate and the response media type this file is served under come from the measured envelope beside it (synthesize-short-en-us.json), not from the page. It is not a transcription of any documented payload: it is a locally computed waveform. No vendor example payload, prose or field description was copied into this repository.

notes: THE OTHER HALF OF A PAIR. `synthesize-short-en-us.json` is the recorded response envelope for this surface — real status, real header names, real media type, real length, real read boundaries — with LMNT's audio counted and discarded rather than written, because protocol section 7 rates the surface not-cleared. This file is the body that envelope describes the shape of, built here rather than taken from LMNT. The media_type above is the type the VENDOR declared on the real response (`application/vnd.lmnt.audio-int16`, measured 2026-08-17) and the type the test serves these bytes under, so the client meets the same declaration it meets in production; the bytes themselves are little-endian int16 PCM, which is what that vendor type denotes. What this pair cannot prove is that LMNT's own audio has any particular content — only a capture could, and the terms do not permit one.
